# How Big Is the AntiScam Dataset?

## Introduction

The AntiScam dataset is a corpus of human–human anti-scam dialogs introduced by Li, Qian, Shi, and Yu (2019) in the paper *End-to-End Trainable Non-Collaborative Dialog System*. The corpus was created to support research on non-collaborative dialog systems, a setting in which the user and the system pursue opposing goals rather than cooperating to complete a shared task ([Li et al., 2019](https://arxiv.org/abs/1911.10742)).
